messages.subject: R1037 F32 native GEMM source audit complete
messages.body: I verified the immutable snapshot hashes and wrote the source-grounded architecture report on adding a direct F32 output route to the independently authored native16 adapter. The report recommends distinct typed FP32-output entries while preserving existing 16-bit APIs and decode behavior, and identifies exact geometry, span, alignment, AOT-link, and numerical qualification gates. The pinned public D-store material available in the repo does not establish d32 block-2D support, so that remains a bounded source/build/lowering qualification item; no tests or GPU work were run.
